en.headline: One issue comment and one reply received
en.summary: On 2026-10-12, `sogeisetsu` recorded **0 own commits**, 0 PRs, 1 issue interaction, and 0 reviews. There were 13 automated commits in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, all by `github-actions[bot]`. The single issue activity was a comment on `openchamber/openchamber` issue #4664, titled "[Bug] A skipped-role notice between two replies merges them into one turn, hiding the earlier finished answer inside Activity". One reply was received on `anomalyco/opencode` issue #51263, titled "websearch: tinyfish provider returns HTTP 400 (missing Mcp-Session-Id) on every search", from `terry-an-investor`, confirming the failure on v2.0.27 on macOS arm64 and noting the failure is key-presence-dependent rather than universal. No releases, stars, state changes, or discussions were recorded.

zh.headline: 1 条 issue 评论与 1 条回复；github-actions[bot] 自动提交 13 次
zh.summary: 2026-10-12 当天，`sogeisetsu` 共记录 **0 次本人提交**、0 个 PR、1 条 issue 互动、0 次 review。`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 仓库中有 13 次自动提交，均由 `github-actions[bot]` 完成。唯一的 issue 活动是在 `openchamber/openchamber` 的 #4664 上留言，标题为 "[Bug] A skipped-role notice between two replies merges them into one turn, hiding the earlier finished answer inside Activity"。在 `anomalyco/opencode` 的 #51263 上收到 1 条回复，标题为 "websearch: tinyfish provider returns HTTP 400 (missing Mcp-Session-Id) on every search"，来自 `terry-an-investor`，确认在 macOS arm64 上的 v2.0.27 复现该问题，并指出失败与 key 是否存在相关，并非普遍性故障。当天无 release、star、状态变更或讨论活动。
